installation.claude:
Requires Claude Code with plugin support and Git. Run in your terminal:

```sh
claude plugin marketplace add https://github.com/ZDreamer2/ai-plugins-claude.git
claude plugin install ai-doc@zd-plugins
claude plugin install ai-marketplace@zd-plugins
```

Install either plugin or both, then start a new Claude Code session. For updates, run `claude plugin marketplace update zd-plugins`, followed by `claude plugin update ai-doc@zd-plugins` and/or `claude plugin update ai-marketplace@zd-plugins`, then restart the session.
installation.codex:
Requires a Codex CLI version with `codex plugin` support and Git. Run in your terminal:

```sh
codex plugin marketplace add https://github.com/ZDreamer2/ai-plugins-codex.git
codex plugin add ai-doc@zd-plugins
codex plugin add ai-marketplace@zd-plugins
```

Install either plugin or both, then start a new Codex session. To refresh the marketplace, run `codex plugin marketplace upgrade zd-plugins`; use `/plugins` in Codex to manage installed plugins and their updates.
installation.pi:
Requires Pi and Git. This repository contains two independent packages, so clone it to a permanent location and install the package directories you need:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/ZDreamer2/ai-plugins-pi.git
pi install ./ai-plugins-pi/ai-doc
pi install ./ai-plugins-pi/ai-marketplace
```

Install either package or both, then start a new Pi session. These are local-path installs: keep the checkout in place. To update, run `git -C ai-plugins-pi pull --ff-only` and start a new session. The repository root is not itself a Pi package.
